CONFIDENCE: 0.18
EXPLANATION: The strongest experimental band at 1652 cm⁻¹ fits well with the C=O stretch of an α,β-unsaturated ketone (typical 1645–1670 cm⁻¹), present only in candidate 1 (trans-4-hexen-3-one). 3081 cm⁻¹ (vinyl C–H stretch) and 2925 cm⁻¹ (aliphatic C–H stretch) match the alkene and alkyl groups in this molecule. Medium bands at 1453 and 1386 cm⁻¹ correspond to CH₃/CH₂ deformations expected for its two terminal ethyl groups. The 776 cm⁻¹ intense feature is consistent with an out-of-plane deformation of a trans-disubstituted alkene. Peaks at 1068 and 1310 cm⁻¹ are assignable to C–C and C=C–C skeletal stretches of an enone chain. No other candidate simultaneously provides a conjugated C=O group, an isolated trans-alkene, and lacks functional groups (NO₂, S, ring) that would introduce extra diagnostic Raman lines not observed.
